form.label: Host detail
form.description: Everything this app knows about one machine: what has been measured on it, what has not, and what to do first.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_hostcadence_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | eval late_flag = if(tonumber(learned) = 1 AND tonumber(late) = 1, "yes", "no") | fields late_flag

| inputlookup riskability_config_lookup where (hostname=$hostname|s$) | eval label = attack . " " . case(kind="cron", "cron jobs", kind="systemd-timer", "systemd timers", kind="systemd-service", "systemd services", kind="suid", "SUID and SGID binaries", kind="sudo-rule", "sudo rules", kind="ssh-authorized-key", "authorized SSH keys", kind="account", "login accounts", kind="kernel-module", "kernel modules", kind="preload", "linker preloads", kind="shell-init", "shell init scripts", kind="scheduled-task", "Scheduled Tasks", kind="autorun", "Run key and Startup autoruns", kind="service", "Windows services", kind="ifeo", "Image File Execution Options debuggers", kind="appinit", "AppInit DLLs", kind="av-exclusion", "Defender exclusions", 1=1, kind)

| inputlookup riskability_hoststate_lookup where _key=$hostname|s$ | lookup riskability_scanstate_lookup hostname OUTPUT swinv_version, os_build, os_display_version, os_edition, scan_profile, full_scan, scanned_at | lookup riskability_matchstate_lookup hostname OUTPUT matched_at, digest_changed_at | lookup riskability_hostcadence_lookup hostname OUTPUT n_gaps, median_gap, learned, late | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_feedstate_lookup where _key="current" | eval feed_at = coalesce(imported_at, built_at) | fields feed_at] | eval os_line = coalesce(os, "unknown") . if(isnull(release) OR release="", "", " " . release) . if(isnull(os_display_version) OR os_display_version="", "", " (" . os_display_version . if(isnull(os_edition) OR os_edition="", "", ", " . os_edition) . ")") | eval machine_line = coalesce(arch, "?") . if(isnull(os_build) OR os_build="", "", " · " . os_build) . if(isnull(machine_id) OR machine_id="", "", " · " . machine_id) | eval rhythm = case( isnull(learned) OR tonumber(learned) != 1, "rhythm not learned, " . coalesce(tostring(n_gaps), "0") . " of 3 intervals seen", tonumber(late) = 1, "late against its own pattern, normally every " . tostring(round(median_gap/3600, 1)) . " h", 1=1, "on its own schedule, normally every " . tostring(round(median_gap/3600, 1)) . " h") | eval collector = coalesce(swinv_version, "version not reported") . if(isnull(scan_profile) OR scan_profile="", ", scan profile not declared", if(full_scan="True" OR full_scan="true", ", full scan", ", partial scan")) | eval h_contact = if(isnull(host_last_scan), null(), round((now() - host_last_scan)/3600, 1)) | eval d_soft = case(isnotnull(digest_changed_at), round((now() - digest_changed_at)/86400, 1), isnotnull(scanned_at), round((now() - scanned_at)/86400, 1), 1=1, null()) | eval h_match = if(isnull(matched_at), null(), round((now() - matched_at)/3600, 1)) | eval d_feed = if(isnull(feed_at), null(), round((now() - feed_at)/86400, 1)) | eval late_flag = if(tonumber(learned) = 1 AND tonumber(late) = 1, 1, 0)

div.b: This host has gone quiet against its own reporting pattern.
div.span: Everything below is frozen at what it last reported and nothing is confirming it. A host that stopped reporting looks exactly like a host with nothing new. This is a collector, forwarder or machine fault, and it is not a statement about the risk on this host.

search.query: | table os_line, machine_line, rhythm, collector | rename os_line AS "Operating system", machine_line AS "Architecture, build, machine id", rhythm AS "Reporting rhythm", collector AS "Collector"

single.option: hours since the collector last ran here, heartbeat included
days since this host's inventory digest changed
hours since this host was matched
days since the vulnerability data was built

div.b: Four different clocks, and nothing below is fresher than the oldest of them.
div.span: Last contact is the collector running at all. Software last changed is a different fact and usually much older: a host that contacted an hour ago and last changed its software in June is not stale, it is confirmed unchanged. None of these is coloured, because how old is too old depends on this host's own rhythm rather than on a number that would have to be right for every machine at once.

panel.title: What has been measured on this host, and what has not

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_scanstate_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_openstate_host_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | fields findings, cves, rolled_at] | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_exposure_hoststate_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | fields listeners, assessed_at] | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_links_hoststate_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | fields link_rows, unowned_libraries] | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_winstate_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | fields status, behind_ubr, latest_ubr] | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_hostcadence_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | fields learned, late, n_gaps] | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_config_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | stats count AS config_rows] | eval shortfall = if(isnull(said_components), null(), said_components - arrived_components) | eval rk = mvappend( "1|Inventory arrived intact|" . case( isnull(said_components), "not assessed;the collector reports no manifest", shortfall > 0, "assessed, failing;" . tostring(shortfall, "commas") . " of " . tostring(said_components, "commas") . " components did not arrive", 1=1, "assessed;all " . tostring(said_components, "commas") . " components arrived") . "|" . coalesce(scanned_at, ""), "2|Collector sources|" . case( isnull(sources_ok), "not assessed;the collector does not report its sources", tonumber(sources_failed) > 0, "assessed, failing;" . failed_text, tonumber(sources_shrank) = 1, "assessed, narrower than last scan;" . tostring(n_sources) . " sources ran, " . tostring(prev_n_sources) . " last time", 1=1, "assessed;" . tostring(n_sources) . " sources ran") . "|" . coalesce(scanned_at, ""), "3|Configuration surface|" . case( isnull(config_rows) OR tonumber(config_rows) = 0, "not assessed;no configuration records, so the probe did not run", 1=1, "assessed;" . tostring(config_rows, "commas") . " mechanisms read") . "|" . coalesce(scanned_at, ""), "4|Listening ports|" . case( isnull(listeners), "not assessed;exposure was never measured on this host", 1=1, "assessed;" . tostring(listeners, "commas") . " listeners") . "|" . coalesce(assessed_at, ""), "5|Library loads|" . case( isnull(link_rows), "not assessed;no link records reached this host", 1=1, "assessed;" . tostring(link_rows, "commas") . " loads, " . tostring(coalesce(unowned_libraries, 0), "commas") . " unowned") . "|" . coalesce(assessed_at, ""), "6|Compared against the feed|" . case( isnull(rolled_at), "not assessed;this host has never been matched", 1=1, "assessed;" . tostring(coalesce(cves, 0), "commas") . " CVEs across " . tostring(coalesce(findings, 0), "commas") . " findings") . "|" . coalesce(rolled_at, ""), "7|Windows patch level|" . case( isnull(status), "not assessed;no build reported, or this is not Windows", isnull(latest_ubr), "not assessed;this build is not in the imported feed", tonumber(behind_ubr) > 0, "assessed, failing;" . tostring(behind_ubr, "commas") . " revisions behind the feed", 1=1, "assessed;current with the feed") . "|" . coalesce(scanned_at, ""), "8|Still reporting|" . case( isnull(learned) OR tonumber(learned) != 1, "not assessed;rhythm not learned, " . coalesce(tostring(n_gaps), "0") . " of 3 intervals seen", tonumber(late) = 1, "assessed, failing;this host has gone quiet against its own pattern", 1=1, "assessed;contacting on its own schedule") . "|" . coalesce(scanned_at, "")) | fields rk | mvexpand rk | eval p = split(rk, "|") | eval ord = tonumber(mvindex(p, 0)), check = mvindex(p, 1) | eval rest = split(mvindex(p, 2), ";") | eval state = mvindex(rest, 0), evidence = mvindex(rest, 1) | eval as_of = mvindex(p, 3) | eval as_of = if(isnull(as_of) OR as_of="", "", strftime(tonumber(as_of), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) | eval rank = case(state="assessed, failing", 1, state="assessed, narrower than last scan", 2, state="not assessed", 3, 1=1, 4) | sort 20 rank, ord | table check, state, evidence, as_of | rename check AS "Check", state AS "State", evidence AS "Evidence", as_of AS "As of"

format.colorPalette: {"assessed, failing":#dc4e41,"assessed, narrower than last scan":#f8be34,"not assessed":#6b5a2a,"assessed":#3f7d7a}

div.b: This says what has been measured, not whether the host is safe.
div.span: A row reading not assessed is a gap in what we looked at, never a clean result, and it is why there is no score here: a number would have to treat those rows as zero or leave them out, and leaving them out rewards a host for being measured less. Ordered failing, then narrower, then not assessed, then assessed. That order is published so it cannot become a hidden weighting.

search.query: | `riskability_reachability_for($hostname|s$, $conf_tok|s$)` | stats count AS findings BY exploit_class, reach_class, tier | fields exploit_class, reach_class, findings, tier

viz.option: Nothing to place. Either this host has no open findings at this confidence, or exposure was never measured on it, in which case every finding sits in "not assessed" rather than being absent.

div.b: Colour is what to do, not how much there is.
div.span: Position is exploitability against reachability, not importance. The not assessed row means exposure was never measured on this host, and it is drawn even when empty so it cannot be mistaken for a row with nothing in it. Click a cell to filter the findings below.

search.query: | `riskability_reachability_for($hostname|s$, $conf_tok|s$)` | search exploit_class=$cell_exploit|s$ reach_class=$cell_reach|s$ | eval age_days = if(isnull(first_seen), null(), round((now() - first_seen)/86400, 1)) | eval epss_pc = if(isnull(epss), null(), round(epss * 100, 1)) | eval kev = if(isnotnull(kev_added) AND kev_added != "", "yes", "") | eval scope = if(isnull(scope_id) OR scope_id="" OR scope_id="/", "host", scope_id) | sort 5000 tier, - exploit_rank, - reach_rank, - epss | table tier, cve_id, package, last_version, fixed_version, scope, reach_class, exploit_class, kev, epss_pc, severity, confidence, age_days | rename tier AS "Do", cve_id AS "CVE", package AS "Package", last_version AS "Installed", fixed_version AS "Fixed in", scope AS "Where", reach_class AS "Reachable here", exploit_class AS "Exploitation", kev AS "Known exploited", epss_pc AS "EPSS %", severity AS "Severity", confidence AS "Confidence", age_days AS "Days open"

viz.option: No open findings match. If a matrix cell above is selected, clear it by reloading the page. No findings at all is not a clean bill: check the ledger for what was never measured.

div.span: What to do first, then whether the world is exploiting it, then whether this copy answers the network, then how likely. Each is a tie-break on the one before it and nothing is added to anything else, so a missing value never becomes a middle one. Reachable here reading not assessed means exposure was never measured on this host, not that nothing listens.

panel.title: What this host is configured to run

search.query: | eval series = if(tonumber(n_evidence) > 0, "flagged by swinv", "surface, no weakness flagged") | stats count AS mechanisms BY label, series | sort 50000 - mechanisms

viz.option: No configuration records for this host. Either the collector ran without the config flag, or it predates swinv 0.8.0. Absence here is missing data, not a hardened host.

search.query: | eval writable = case(world_writable="true" OR world_writable=1, "anyone can write it", isnull(world_writable) OR world_writable="", "", 1=1, "no") | eval flagged = if(tonumber(n_evidence) > 0, n_evidence, "none") | eval owner = if(isnull(purl) OR purl="", "no package owns this", replace(replace(purl, "^pkg:[^/]+/", ""), "\?.*$", "")) | sort 50000 - n_evidence, kind, name | table kind, attack, name, path, executable, user, schedule, owner, mode, writable, flagged | rename kind AS "Kind", attack AS "Technique", name AS "Name", path AS "Path", executable AS "Runs", user AS "Runs as", schedule AS "Schedule", owner AS "Owning package", mode AS "Mode", writable AS "World writable", flagged AS "Weaknesses flagged"

viz.option: No configuration records for this host.

div.b: What the host is configured to run, not a flaw in it.
div.span: Weaknesses flagged is swinv's own count, carried through and never re-derived here, because it knows a context an outside join does not. A kind with no rows means nothing was found inside this scan's configuration scope; on a collector below 0.8.0 it means the probe never ran. Filter the Kind column for Defender exclusions, cron or Scheduled Tasks.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_exposure_lookup where (hostname=$hostname|s$) | eval where = case(bind_scope="any", "any address", bind_scope="one", "one address", bind_scope="loopback", "loopback only", 1=1, coalesce(bind_scope, "not stated")) | sort 5000 bind_scope, port | table port, protocol, address, where, executable, unit, container | rename port AS "Port", protocol AS "Protocol", address AS "Bound to", where AS "Reach", executable AS "Process", unit AS "Service", container AS "Container"

viz.option: No listening ports recorded. If exposure was never measured on this host, that is not the same as nothing listening: the ledger above says which it is.

div.b: An empty table here has two meanings and the ledger tells them apart.
div.span: Measured and nothing listening is a result. Never measured is a gap. This panel refuses to merge them into a zero. A port whose process could not be named is still a port: that is not "no process".

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_winstate_lookup where hostname=$hostname|s$ | eval distance = case(isnull(latest_ubr), "not in the feed", tonumber(behind_ubr) <= 0, "up to date", 1=1, tostring(behind_ubr, "commas") . " revisions behind") | table product, release, current_build, build_source, latest_build, latest_kb, latest_released, distance, n_installed_kbs | rename product AS "Windows release", release AS "Version", current_build AS "Build it is on", build_source AS "Where that came from", latest_build AS "Build the feed knows", latest_kb AS "That update", latest_released AS "Released", distance AS "Distance", n_installed_kbs AS "Standalone KBs"

div.b: Empty here means not assessed, and that is three different things.
div.span: This panel is Windows only: Riskability compares components against CVE data and does not track vendor update streams, so on Linux there is nothing to show and that is not a gap. On Windows an empty row means no cumulative update was reported, which is a collector below swinv 0.9.0, or a bundle built without the Windows update source. None of those is a patched host.
div.b: When it does report, it is the only assessment here that does not infer.
div.span: The host reports the build it is running, Microsoft states the build each update produces, and the two are compared. Distance counts revisions behind the newest build the imported feed knows, not the newest Microsoft has shipped, so a stale feed makes a stale host look current. Where that came from matters: a build derived from the cumulative update component names the servicing branch and can name the wrong release while still getting the update right.

panel.title: Can the feed even see this host's software?

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_hostecostate_lookup where (hostname=$hostname|s$) | stats sum(instances) AS instances, sum(cpe_ident) AS cpe_ident BY type | append [| `riskability_feed_ecosystems` | rename ecosystem AS type] | eventstats max(eval(if(type=="cpe", feed_ranges, null()))) AS cpe_ranges | stats max(instances) AS instances, max(cpe_ident) AS cpe_ident, max(feed_ranges) AS feed_ranges, max(cpe_ranges) AS cpe_ranges BY type | where isnotnull(instances) | eval feed_ranges = coalesce(feed_ranges, 0) | eval status = case( feed_ranges > 0, "covered", cpe_ident > 0 AND cpe_ranges > 0, "covered through CPE", type IN ("linux-kernel-module","linux-kernel","github-action","github-action-workflow","binary","hotfix"), "no feed exists for this type", 1=1, "add this ecosystem to the bundle") | stats sum(instances) AS instances BY status | sort 10 - instances

viz.option: No inventory recorded for this host, so there is nothing to assess coverage of.

div.b: Every installed instance on this host is in exactly one of these four states.
div.span: The circle sums to installed instances, not distinct package names, which is a different and larger number than the one on Coverage. No feed exists for this type is a measured category rather than a gap in what we looked at: it is why part of this machine can never produce a finding at all. Add this ecosystem to the bundle is the only slice you can act on.
